policyEngines.name: DefaultCedar
policyEngines.description: Cedar policy engine for default-gateway. Associated in LOG_ONLY mode (evaluates and logs decisions without blocking) — tool calls are not yet routed through the gateway (#273), so ENFORCE has no effect yet. Policies below are static smoke tests; #272 replaces them with policies generated from GroupToolGrant (Cognito group -> MCP tool grants, web/amplify/data/schemas/agentConfig.schema.ts).

policies.name: AdminAllowAllTools
policies.description: Smoke test: principals with the Cognito "admin" group claim may call any tool on default-gateway. Mirrors GroupToolGrant's admin/*/ALLOW convention. Cognito's custom:groups / cognito:groups claim is expected to arrive as a JWT tag on AgentCore::OAuthUser; exact tag name depends on the gateway's CUSTOM_JWT claim mapping and will be confirmed in #272 when policies are generated from real grants.

policies.name: DefaultDenyUnauthenticated
policies.description: Smoke test: forbid tool calls from callers with no recognized OAuth principal, making default-deny explicit while no other policies exist yet. Cedar already default-denies with no matching permit, so this is a documentation/smoke policy, not a behavior change on its own.
